# algizian_provider_credentials (Resource)

Use the tenant's own Google, Microsoft or Apple app, so the consent screen shows your name. **The provider's `sub` changes with the app** (Microsoft per app registration, Apple per team, Google not at all): after switching, existing users re-match only by verified email. Decide before users exist. Register the redirect URIs that `GET /tenants/{t}/providers` lists (every sign-in host of the tenant). Secrets are stored encrypted by Algizian and never returned, so they live in the Terraform state (sensitive).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "algizian_provider_credentials" "google" {
  tenant        = algizian_tenant.myapp.slug
  provider_name = "google"
  client_id     = "123456-example.apps.googleusercontent.com"
  client_secret = var.google_client_secret
}

resource "algizian_provider_credentials" "apple" {
  tenant        = algizian_tenant.myapp.slug
  provider_name = "apple"
  client_id     = "com.example.myapp.signin"
  team_id       = "ABCDE12345"
  key_id        = "KEY1234567"
  private_key   = file("${path.module}/AuthKey_KEY1234567.p8")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) Google: `123-abc.apps.googleusercontent.com`; Microsoft: the application (client) id; Apple: the Services ID.
- `provider_name` (String) `google`, `microsoft` or `apple`.
- `tenant` (String)

### Optional

- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Google and Microsoft.
- `domain_association` (String) Apple: optional domain association file content.
- `key_id` (String) Apple.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) Apple: the `.p8` key (PEM text).
- `team_id` (String) Apple.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <tenant slug>/<provider>; the secrets cannot be read back
terraform import algizian_provider_credentials.google k3x9q2a/google
```
